notes: Not a v0.1.46 regression — the v0.1.46 bug/migration/doctor tests are pure tmp_path units. Likely a real-mypy subprocess test (contract/test_lease_probe_residue.py or contract/cli/test_cli_ci.py) with cwd defaulting to repo. Found during v0.1.46 QA.
symptom: Running the full pytest suite from repos/dadaia-workspace root creates .mypy_cache/3.12/ in the repo working tree (gitignored, untracked, mtime mid-run), violating the repo-cleanliness law despite the conftest snapshot-guard listing .mypy_cache.
title: Full pytest suite leaves .mypy_cache in repo working tree
